axioms.statement: Authority is a system, not a person.
Channels are additive: new distribution channels join old ones.
Consecrating authority migrates: a new consecrator displaces the prior one.

gatekeepers: Académie Royale de Peinture et de Sculpture

field_state.visibility_regime: Distribution through print and the biennial Salon; discovery mediated by the Académie and private subscriber networks (W2: separate layers)
sayable_set: color is the soul of painting (contested, sayable after 1673)
criticism as sentimental performance (anomalous until c. 1765)

diagnostic_questions.question: Are authority structures of the period named or contested, never assumed?

source.note: Not independently verified, except that the Cours de peinture of 1708 carries a royal censor's approbation (Raguet, 19 Jan 1708), which supports 'royal censors' as a gatekeeper.
